description: Our team consists of two friends who share a passion for space and protecting the environment. I have been fascinated by space since childhood, and as I grew older, I became increasingly concerned about pollution, its effects on wildlife, and environmental impacts on human health. We wanted to combine our interests in space and environmental science to create Earth Doctor and inspire others to better understand and protect our planet.
summary:
Earth Doctor is an interactive environmental science dashboard designed to make Earth's complex systems easier to explore and understand. The project brings together three main areas: Inside Earth, Around Earth, and Global Trends. It combines scientific datasets, interactive visualizations, monitoring tools, and educational explanations to help users investigate environmental processes and changes over time.

The Around Earth section features two views: atmospheric ozone monitoring, including ozone-hole measurements and historical records, and the orbital environment, featuring orbital debris information and space weather monitoring. The Trends section helps users examine long-term environmental patterns and interpret changes through data analysis.

EARTH DOCTOR addresses the challenge of becoming an Earth System Trend Detective by transforming scientific data into an accessible, interactive experience. It is important because understanding Earth's systems and identifying environmental trends can help people build scientific awareness, recognize changes in our planet, and make more informed decisions about its future.
details:
Earth Doctor is an interactive environmental science platform that helps people understand how Earth works, how human activities affect the planet, and what can be done to protect it. The project is organized into three main sections: Inside Earth, Around Earth, and Global Trends. Each section uses scientific data, interactive visualizations, and educational information to make complex environmental topics easier to understand.

One of the project's main creative aspects is that it considers a wide range of human impacts that are often overlooked. For example, it explores orbital debris and the growing amount of human-made objects surrounding Earth, alongside atmospheric ozone conditions and other environmental changes. It also aims to use AI to provide information and recommendations that are relevant to individual countries, helping people understand the environmental challenges affecting their own regions and how they can contribute to solutions.

Throughout development, our team considered why people would care about the information, which environmental factors were most important to include, and how relevant and meaningful each feature would be. We wanted to go beyond simply displaying statistics by raising awareness of the consequences of human activities and helping users understand why these issues matter. Accessibility, scientific relevance, educational value, and real-world impact were important considerations in our decisions.

The project was developed using JavaScript, React, CSS, and Vite, along with data visualization and mapping technologies. We incorporated scientific information and datasets from sources such as NASA, NOAA, ESA, and CelesTrak to support the monitoring and visualization features.

The intended impact of EARTH DOCTOR is to encourage environmental awareness, curiosity, and informed action. By connecting scientific observations with human impacts and country-relevant guidance, the project aims to help people recognize that protecting Earth is a shared responsibility and that understanding the problem is an important first step toward making a difference.
